nodes.name: style.css
nodes.summary: The blog's single global stylesheet: defines the design system via --mn-* custom properties (cream-paper light palette with a full dark-mode override, five surface/border steps, walnut text ramp, spacing ladder, --mn-col-width, and accent colors coral/rose/emerald/sky/indigo), self-hosted @font-face faces (Source Serif 4, Computer Modern 'CMS'/'CMSS', Utopia-derivative 'Lingua Franca'), and all component styles for the course shell and lesson widgets — typography with drop caps and Butterick rules, Tufte-style sidenotes and margin figures, callouts/code blocks, aurora color clusters, search overlay, theme toggle, module nav, mobile drawer, glossary tooltips, topic-block dim/collapse states, course-progress tiles, plus ~1,000 dark-mode inline-style rescue rules for lab pages and a final guardrail block locking drop-cap layout and word-breaking.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS custom-property design tokens (992 --mn-* occurrences) as the single source of truth; html.dark re-declares the token set for dark mode; attribute-selector overrides ([style*="..."]) patch inline-styled lab content rather than editing each lab; guardrail blocks are deliberately placed at the very end of the file to win the cascade.
